clinic.name: Falls Family Dental
clinic.tagline: We’re Fully Invested in Your Smile
clinic.heroSubtitle: Restore your smile, regain full chewing function, and enjoy lasting confidence with dental implants from Falls Family Dental. Our advanced solutions offer a permanent replacement for missing or failing teeth, designed to look, feel, and function just like your natural smile. We focus on ensuring your comfort and providing personalized attention throughout your journey to a healthier, more complete smile.

differentiators.title: Patient-Centered Care
differentiators.description: This practice invests fully in your smile, ensuring your comfort and satisfaction with personalized attention.

differentiators.title: Advanced Technology
differentiators.description: Utilizing digital X-rays and laser treatment for precise and effective dental care.

differentiators.title: Flexible Financing Options
differentiators.description: Accepts most major insurance, offers CareCredit and Sunbit, and an in-house savings plan for affordability.

differentiators.title: Free Second Opinions
differentiators.description: Provides complimentary second opinions to ensure certainty and confidence in your treatment decisions.

treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a thorough examination, including digital X-rays and 3D scans, to assess your oral health and precisely plan your implant placement.

treatmentJourney.title: Preparation & Foundation Work
treatmentJourney.description: Any necessary preliminary treatments, such as extractions or bone grafting, will be performed to create a healthy and strong foundation for your dental implants.

treatmentJourney.title: Implant Surgical Placement
treatmentJourney.description: The titanium implant post is precisely and gently placed into your jawbone, acting as a stable root for your new tooth.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: A crucial healing period follows, during which the implant integrates with your jawbone, forming a strong and permanent bond.

treatmentJourney.title: Abutment Placement & Impressions
treatmentJourney.description: Once healed, a small connector (abutment) is attached to the implant, and impressions are taken to custom-create your new restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Permanent Restoration & Care
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom crown, bridge, or arch is securely attached, completing your new smile. We'll then provide a long-term care plan for optimal longevity.

benefits.title: Permanent Tooth Replacement
benefits.description: Dental implants offer a long-lasting and durable solution for missing teeth.

benefits.title: Restores Chewing Function
benefits.description: Regain the ability to eat all your favorite foods with comfort and confidence.

benefits.title: Preserves Jawbone Health
benefits.description: Implants stimulate the jawbone, preventing the bone loss common after tooth extraction.

benefits.title: Natural Look and Feel
benefits.description: Designed to seamlessly blend with your natural teeth in appearance and function.

benefits.title: Enhanced Speech Clarity
benefits.description: Stable implants eliminate the speech impediments often associated with missing teeth or dentures.

benefits.title: Boosts Self-Confidence
benefits.description: Enjoy a complete and beautiful smile, significantly improving your self-esteem.

implantOptions.title: Single Tooth Implants
implantOptions.description: Replace one missing tooth with a durable implant and natural-looking crown.

implantOptions.title: Multiple Tooth Implants
implantOptions.description: Restore several missing teeth with strategically placed implants for a secure, long-lasting solution.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Bridges
implantOptions.description: Replace multiple adjacent missing teeth without relying on natural teeth for support.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Dentures
implantOptions.description: Secure dentures to dental implants for improved comfort, stability, and chewing function.

implantOptions.title: All-on-4 Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Restore a full arch of teeth using four strategically placed implants and a fixed prosthesis.

implantOptions.title: Same-Day Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Receive implants and a temporary restoration in a single visit, reducing treatment time and restoring your smile quickly.

faqItems.question: How long does the entire implant process take?
faqItems.answer: The complete dental implant process typically spans several months, allowing for proper healing and osseointegration after implant placement. Your individual timeline will be discussed during your initial consultation.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for dental implants if I have bone loss?
faqItems.answer: Many patients with bone loss can still be candidates for dental implants. We can assess your specific situation and discuss potential solutions like bone grafting during your consultation to determine eligibility.

faqItems.question: How much do dental implants cost, and what financing options are available?
faqItems.answer: The cost of dental implants varies based on individual needs. Falls Family Dental works with most major insurance providers, offers CareCredit and Sunbit financing, and has an in-house dental savings plan to make treatment affordable.

faqItems.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and oral hygiene, dental implants can last for many decades, often a lifetime. They are a durable and long-term solution for tooth replacement.

faqItems.question: Is implant surgery painful, and what sedation do you offer?
faqItems.answer: Our team prioritizes your comfort during implant procedures. We offer various sedation options to ensure a pain-free and relaxing experience, which will be discussed during your treatment planning.

faqItems.question: What is the best option for replacing missing teeth: implants, bridges, or dentures?
faqItems.answer: The best option depends on your individual needs and oral health. Dental implants offer a permanent, stable solution that closely mimics natural teeth, while bridges and dentures are also viable. We will help you choose the best treatment for your situation.

doctor.name: Dr. Sandra Thore
doctor.bio: For over 30 years, Dr. Sandra Thore has dedicated herself to providing exceptional dental care, ensuring every patient receives her full attention. She believes in empowering patients by thoroughly explaining their treatment options, allowing them to make informed decisions with complete confidence. Dr. Thore's gentle nature and commitment to making sure everything is "absolutely perfect" have earned the trust of multiple generations of families in Raleigh, making each visit a positive and comforting experience.
